description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage team building AI-powered software for supply chain connectivity. You will help create the platform that runs mission-critical integrations, contributing across agent development and infrastructure.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build purpose-specific AI coding agents for supply chain connectivity.

 - Develop and maintain the infrastructure for hosting and running integrations.

 - Own core systems end to end, from the agent platform to the integrations runtime, and make foundational architecture decisions.

 - Establish engineering patterns and practices as the team and product grow.

 - Work across agentic product development and complex infrastructure systems.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to five years of experience as a full-stack or backend software engineer.

 - Proficiency in TypeScript and modern full-stack product development.

 - Hands-on experience building with AI agents and LLMs using current approaches.

 - Experience building backend or infrastructure systems, such as runtimes, orchestration, or cloud platforms.

 - Experience in a VC-backed startup, ideally at an early stage, and the ability to build from scratch with autonomy.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $150,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States.
